draft.emotion: assertive and focused, setting a clear intention
notes: Modal verb with irregular singular forms: ich will, du willst, er will; past: wollte, hat gewollt.
For polite requests (like ordering food), use 'ich möchte' (I would like) instead of 'ich will', which sounds demanding.
Do not confuse with the English false friend 'will': the German future tense uses 'werden', not 'wollen'.
When the direction or place is clear, the main motion verb can be omitted: 'Ich will nach Hause' (I want [to go] home).
